verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ tool with a command-line interface (`llama cli`) and an HTTP server (`llama serve`). It also ships Docker images, pre-built release binaries and a Winget package, which together support headless, scriptable deployment in automation pipelines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI usage or non-interactive/batch-mode flags, and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI pipelines.
